GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproduction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproduction.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Mole 2.3 Hydrocarbons 3.0 Natural Physical Science 3.1 Thin Lenses 3.2 Newto? (1 mark)
